newsitem.title: USA: Fountain Oil to redeem warrants.
newsitem.headline: Fountain Oil to redeem warrants.

text.p: Fountain Oil Inc said Friday it called for redemption 3.2 million stock purchase warrants expiring February 28, 1997 that entitle holders to purchase Fountain Oil shares at $6 a share.
At the close of business on December 31, Fountain Oil said it will redeem and acquire all of the remaining outstanding and unexercised warrants at a redemption price of $0.01 per warrant.
Before December 31, holders can exercise the warrants, the company said.
The maximum proceeds to Fountain Oil from the exercise of warrants, if all warrants were exercised, would be about $19.5 million, Fountain Oil said.
